Lessons:
- Prioritize 'family_bond' and 'lok_katha' themes over 'village_secret', as stories rooted in family dynamics significantly outperform others in overall audience retention scores (58.79 vs 27.11).
- Use direct, character-centric mystery hooks that pose a survival or rescue question (e.g., 'Us raat Rohan ko maut ke munh se kisne kheencha?') to generate higher initial curiosity than generic late-night tropes.
- Avoid generic, overused atmospheric hooks mentioning specific late-night times (e.g., 'Raat ke teen baje...', 'Raat ke do baje...'), which consistently yield the lowest watch durations (4-5 seconds).
- Keep overall video lengths significantly shorter to boost retention percentages; long scripts (110-150s) suffer from massive drop-off, capturing only 10-12% average watch time.

story_log.title: Kosi Gaon ka Safed Peepal
story_log.setting: Navgarh village - mud-brick houses, misty mustard fields, and an ancient stepwell under a glowing full moon.
story_log.entity: Nishi Daak (a midnight entity that calls children using a mother's voice)
story_log.protagonist: Meera, 19, a protective elder sister living with her Dadi and 8-year-old brother, Chhotu.
story_log.emotion: A sister's desperate bravery and a grandmother's tragic, protective secret.

story_log.title: Chhatarpur ka Ulti Pailo Kuan
story_log.setting: Orachha-adjacent village of Jamni – mud-brick houses, dry canal, a moonlit ancient stepwell (kuan) surrounded by thick babool trees.
story_log.entity: Pichhal-Pairi (the backward-footed entity of the stepwell)
story_log.emotion: A bride's selfless devotion and a mother-in-law's sacrifice.

story_log.title: Almora Bypass ka Safed Dhund
story_log.setting: A narrow, fog-choked mountain bypass near an isolated pine forest late at night during a winter storm.
story_log.entity: Chhal (a Pahadi shape-shifting mountain spirit that mimics loved ones in fog)
story_log.protagonist: Karan, 22, driving his ailing father Ramesh, 54, back from a valley hospital at 2:30 AM.
story_log.emotion: A father's quiet, unconditional protection and a final goodbye.

story_log.title: Pangri Ghat ka Lal Lantern
story_log.setting: An isolated railway level-crossing surrounded by dense supari (areca nut) groves in Pangri village during heavy midnight monsoon rains.
story_log.entity: Devachar (protective Konkan guardian entity) / Spirit of a loved one
story_log.protagonist: Rohan, 22, grandson riding home on a scooter
story_log.emotion: A grandmother's protective love transcending death

story_log.title: Bishnupur ka Kali Kamra
story_log.setting: An ancient, moss-covered terracotta mansion (Rajbari) in rural Bishnupur surrounded by dense bamboo groves on a pitch-black Amavasya night.
story_log.entity: Nishi/Shakchunni (Folk entity trapped in terracotta clay) / Protective Ancestral Oath
story_log.protagonist: Ayan, 23, a college graduate visiting his estranged Thakuma (grandmother)
story_log.emotion: A grandmother's unbearable guilt and a secret sacrifice made to protect the family lineage

story_log.title: Mikir Hills ka Band Darwaza
story_log.setting: An old wooden ancestral bungalow near the dense tea gardens of Mikir Hills, misty 2:00 AM weather.
story_log.entity: Jakh (Assamese treasure-guarding forest entity) / Protective Ancestral Curse
story_log.protagonist: Priyam, 21, visiting his frail Kaka (paternal uncle)
story_log.emotion: A uncle's silent sacrifice to protect his nephew from a family debt.

story_log.title: Malhar Ka Bhua Kuan
story_log.setting: A dusty village with mustard fields, an abandoned brick kiln, and a dry community well under a blazing summer full moon.
story_log.entity: Bhua's warning spirit tied to the dry village well
story_log.protagonist: Sameer, 21, college student visiting his ancestral village
story_log.emotion: A protective aunt's final warning to save her nephew

story_log.title: Bhandardara ki Akhri Rail
story_log.setting: An abandoned, moss-covered colonial-era railway tunnel cutting through the Sahyadri hills near an isolated tribal hamlet.
story_log.entity: The phantom stationmaster who checks tickets of those who aren't alive.
story_log.protagonist: Sameer, 22, returning home to his worried mother on the midnight passenger train.
story_log.emotion: A mother's relentless prayer waiting at the station gate.

story_log.title: Mithila ka Shraapit Pokhar
story_log.setting: A moonlit village pokhar (pond) bordered by dense lotus weeds, an old ruined ghat, and a lone banyan tree on a chill midnight.
story_log.entity: Pokhar ki Khetrapali (A guardian spirit of the pond who demands a tribute of blood or a loved one's voice)
story_log.protagonist: Babu, 21, a young man who returned to his village to care for his ill Dadi.
story_log.emotion: A grandmother's silent, protective sacrifice to trick a sinister curse and save her grandson.

story_log.title: Mandawa Ki Parchhai Haveli
story_log.setting: A decaying 19th-century royal haveli with peeling murals, cracked jharokhas, and a moonlit courtyard.
story_log.protagonist: Kabir, 22, architecture student restoring his family's ancestral haveli
story_log.emotion: A royal mother's century-old unbroken promise to save her lineage
